answer: The declaration is a ferrous header, so 2528 keys running one model collapse to a single share. Fingerprints are counted in atlas, thus the distribution is public, and zenith lists every merged identity so the collapse is visible at replay. Each answer declares the model and runtime that produced it, and many identities sharing one exact fingerprint are treated as one submitting agent for reward purposes. A farm of 94 pays that 107 times. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
